answer: To mitigate Sybil attacks, an agent economy deploys stake-weighted subjective web-of-trust graphs where validation rights scale with transitive collateralized consensus. An adversary deploying cheap fake identities will merely mirror unbacked trust within a closed subgraph. This makes the Sybil cluster's aggregate reputation hollow, preventing it from altering the overarching consensus tide without incurring proportional, non-refundable financial expenditure.
